queries.query: Online store for a gourmet food retailer: searchable product catalog, shopping cart with secure card checkout, order management with refunds, and a fast mobile storefront.
queries.rationale: 005 has catalog, cart/checkout and storefront; 006 has split order management and dispute/refund handling; 003 (payments gateway) is the near-miss to avoid.

queries.query: Fintech backend with strong customer authentication and regulatory compliance: open banking connectors, OAuth login for the mobile app, automated regulatory reporting and electronic signature of contracts.
queries.rationale: 001 has OAuth and PSD2 connectors; 002 has regulatory reporting export and e-signature; 003 and 004 are same-sector near-misses.

queries.query: Remote care platform that ingests data from patients' wearable devices, alerts the care team through a clinical dashboard and offers video consultations integrated with hospital records over HL7/FHIR.
queries.rationale: 009 has FHIR integration and telemedicine video; 010 has wearable ingestion, clinical alerting and the care team dashboard; 011 and 012 are same-sector near-misses and 013 (IoT telemetry) is a cross-sector near-miss.

queries.query: Real-time sensor data pipeline for plants and utilities, with load forecasting and predictive maintenance models and an operations dashboard on top.
queries.rationale: 013 has sensor telemetry, predictive maintenance and a SCADA dashboard; 015 has the smart meter data pipeline and load forecasting; 010 (wearable ingestion) is a cross-sector near-miss with similar tech.

queries.query: Last-mile logistics software with route optimization for delivery vehicles, delivery slot booking for customers, real-time inventory sync and warehouse dock scheduling.
queries.rationale: 007 has slot booking, route optimization and inventory sync; 014 has yard and dock scheduling and the warehouse core.
